title: PACK THAT!
oneLiner: Pack colorful crates into matching trucks before the conveyor jams!
mechanics: Move the tiny packer left and right along the loading bay; press A to grab the nearest crate and pack it into the matching truck.
Correctly packed crates score 100 points; chain up to 5 deliveries for a multiplier, with a quick pickup-and-pack route rewarding precision.
Loose crates slide across three conveyor lanes as hazards; avoid crashing into them, and use B to briefly stop the conveyor once every 8 seconds.
The first 10 seconds show slow single crates, then add alternating lanes and short recovery pauses; cap at three loose crates and 1.5x speed.

controls.a: Grab and pack the nearest matching crate
controls.b: Stop the conveyor for 1 second; cooldown 8 seconds

lose: Lose a life after three collisions with loose crates or when the loading timer expires with an overfilled jam meter.
scoring: Score 100 for each correct delivery, plus a chain multiplier up to 5x; a miss resets the chain.
